newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose 67.73 poitns to 6,833.10. PLDT's ADR slipped $0.25 to $58.50.
* On Friday, the peso weakend to 26.311 to a U.S. dollar from 26.299.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,294.31, up 4.12 points.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was steady at 10.53125 pct.
* The regional tripartite wages and productivity board in the National Capital Region is closing in on a 20 peso increase in the 165 peso daily minimum wage in Metro Manila (BUSINESS DAILY)
* Robinson's Land Corp posted a net income of 600.11 million pesos in the last fiscal year, a significant 79.11 percent increase over the same period in 1995. (PHILIPPINE DAILY INQUIRER)
* The World Bank and the International Monetary Fund are pushing for the merger of the Social Security System and the Government Service Insurance System into a provident fund (PHILIPPINE STAR)

* The Manila Electric Co asks the Supreme Court to stop labour secretary Leonardo Quisumbing from enforcing an order awarding 907.461 million pesos in wage increases, bonuses, and other benefits to its rank and file employees. (BUSINESSWORLD)
* Interest rates of Treasury bills are expected to be stable in today's weekly auction, traders said. (BUSINESSWORLD)
